intake.matter_summary: Client rear-ended while stopped at a red light on an icy morning; contested liability and disputed neck/shoulder injuries. Seeks representation to pursue a personal-injury claim after a low insurer settlement offer.

conflicts_check.notes: No prior or current representation of Douglas Ashcombe or his liability insurer; no relationship with the independent witness. No conflict identified.

time_entries.narrative: Initial client interview and case assessment; review of client's account and scene photographs.
Open matter file; obtain Elleston Police traffic crash report and field diagram.
Request client's medical records and billing from treating providers; begin damages summary.
Interview independent eyewitness Rafael Quesada; prepare witness statement.
Draft complaint for negligence; assemble factual allegations from case file.
Review, finalize, and file complaint in Meridian District Court, Marrick County.
Propound written discovery; prepare subpoena for defendant's cellular records; obtain independent repair appraisal.
Review defense independent medical examination report; confer with treating physician regarding causation.
Prepare for depositions; organize exhibits and chronology.
Client counseling regarding insurer's settlement offer and range of outcomes.
Draft settlement demand and prepare for mediation.
Trial preparation; draft opening outline and direct/cross examination outlines.
